tools.description:
API keys. Pass required `action` to choose the REST call.

- `list` — List API keys (GET /api-keys). No extra required fields.
- `create` — Create API key (POST /api-keys). Required: body.
- `revoke` — Revoke API key (DELETE /api-keys/{id}). Required: id.

Pass idempotency_key on write actions. Omit fields that do not apply to the chosen action.

idempotency_key.description: Optional Idempotency-Key header (recommended on writes for safe retries).
